said on Wednesday that its wholly owned subsidiary, AIR, priced $425M of senior unsecured notes due 2031 at a 7.875% coupon.

The proceeds will mainly be used to refinance the existing term loan and revolving credit facilities, with the remainder for general corporate purposes, including related interest, fees, and expenses.
The offering is expected to close around October 1, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

title: AIR Global prices $425M senior notes at 7.875% to refinance debt
